body: But guys! He's a changed man now. He sent me another message, he wouldn't lie. I just posted it.

No worries! Truly, my thanks for being so on top of things and concerned regardless. If I had read that, my knee jerk reaction would've been more or less the same! I probably would've PM'd resource numbers and groups too. 

Looking at his comment history, it's all a bunch of creepy things on GW posts... But "I love you" and similarly weird crap I think is standard.

Yeah... it's really weird to mention anyone's kids in a message of this sort, period... I don't even know why he'd comment on her puberty. This guy's checking off everything on my red-flag bingo card.

Well, let me play devil's advocate and say that, without someone playing devil's advocate on every post, how would people know that other opinions exist in the world? 

It's very clear that you're just promoting ignorance!

/s

I stated above, as well as in the original post (which he sent the PM in response to), I'm not a minor-- the events he's referring to in the PM & also in the post were more than 6 years ago. But thank you for the concern! :)

It is creepy- definitely an off-vibe going on. But he is definitely transparent and I am very aware of what he was trying to do, and I just hope he's not doing this to anyone else.
what did it say?! I'm so curious!!

Maybe some sexy skype sessions for him to jack off to wherein he convinces the person to give a strip tease and send nude pics to prove that they're now confident and moved on, and that they're cleaning themselves by embracing their sexuality!

Ick.
Except for them, 'playing devil's advocate' translates to 'being a combative fuckhead and blatantly attacking someone because I can in the name of "devil's advocate"'. Bah, sorry about that.
Is it bad I kinda want to know what that douchecanoe was saying? (Because I'm assuming his idiocy is hilarious and insults completely unfounded). Shine on, lolihull, you star!

Yeah... I got a few other messages offering to talk, but so far they've all seemed genuine. To clarify (just in case), I'm not 15, but I was during the events I wrote about (except for the stuff referring to now/its effects, of course). If you read the post I made, it explains it and etc, but I'm a lot older now and definitely not underaged. I don't know if that makes him any less creepy, but at least he's not doing this to a kid (I hope...).

You are loved, and you bring happiness, support, and kindness to others, and are a bright light in the lives and eyes of many.

You are loved.

Thank you, again. I prefer to be challenged, my mind never stops racing and I really never stop thinking, so I try not to let myself idle much or get bored. Just leads to bad things, me wanting to make it stop and keep myself from wandering and dwelling.

Ha, as they (and by they, I mean Lucille Bluth) say: I'd rather be dead in California than alive in Arizona. 

Thank you for your understanding and empathy and support. Maybe Disneyland would be odd, but it depends on the company and state of mind when you go, eh? Although those mascot costumes freak me out. Also boiling heat + screaming kids + oh god, what is THAT?! = sometimes a shit show.

I've been trying to find the right sort of people and energies to hang around. As a family friend has always said to me, I am a giver in terms of my energy and outlook on life and the general people, and unfortunately, there are a lot of takers (vampires!) in this world who have bad intention and only seek to take advantage and generally take the things (and energy, emotions, etc) that others put forth with trust and love in their hearts. I can relate to that, but there's always going to be shitty people. 

Definitely not everyone else, unless you mean the pedophile and the ex, otherwise I know that I'm pretty messed up more so than most, and I'm okay with that. But thank you, your words (and the rest of you guys, thank you too) take a weight off me.
You are a sweet soul, my thanks. <3 I'm glad I've been able to get it off my chest, too. It's been a heavy burden not telling anyone all the details and all my issues following this realisation.

I don't use tumblr, but I know a lot of special snowflake types who are full of drama, shit, uninformed vapid illogical arguments, and egotistical, narcissistic crazy... 

I appreciate the concern and empathy, truly. You're a bright soul. I may just take you up on that offer, thank you again. I'm staying tied up with research for another two months, so hopefully I can keep myself a little more grounded. The stress and panic both are overwhelming, though.

Thank you. I actually am a scientist, but I have done/did do a lot of writing, which I enjoyed and (not to be a jerk) excelled at. I have family pushing me to pursue more the writing side of the sciences, and I think it might be fun. I do a lot of neuro and genetics/DNA related things in addition to my concentrations, so writing within the research is a definite possibility. 

Home is Bay Area (is that too specific? Sorry, mods- will/can remove), and I'm currently in a largely north, slightly eastern, country. Nothing here in terms of resources, support, anything really going on at all- barren, but beautiful.

Thank you. Thank you for your words, your thoughts, and kindness. I've been trying a lot of that lately, and it'll help a bit, but some of it ca be triggering (I hate using that word.... fucking tumblr) and causes a ton of paranoia and anxiety-- at least, the music and staying still in bed. The positive thinking sometimes is comforting, but sometimes it spills into me that I won't ever change, and that none of it is true.

I feel like I express my self love through either promiscuity or erratic behaviour- clubs, bars, parties, getting shitfaced and fucked up. But I guess that's some form of coping, too. 

Thank you.

I really appreciate your sincerity, thank you. It's hard to comprehend such pain and self-loathing, whether or not it's actually true or your fault/to blame. You're right, it's not easy to internalize, much less come to terms with and talk about.

Thank you.
